_comment: Vivy Runtime Registry — Declares environment identity, ownership, and expected capabilities. The Runtime Manager resolves actual executables from 'relative_path' at startup and validates them against 'expected'. If validation fails, Vivy reports a discrepancy and uses a safe fallback rather than silently breaking.

main.description: Main Vivy runtime environment for API, Orchestration, CPU ML, Memory, TTS, STT.

rvc.description: Specialized CUDA PyTorch environment for RVC voice conversion inference and neural training.

avatar.description: Lightweight Python 3.12 environment for the MateEngine Unity WebSocket bridge. NOTE: Investigation shows this environment may be architecturally redundant (avatar_bridge.py has no Python 3.12-specific code and MAIN already has a newer websockets version). Retained for stability; do not delete without explicit review.
